scope: Genuine interlaced Stereo High MVC transport source with AVC base PID0x1011 and view1 extension PID0x1012. Custom TS/PES base extraction matches independent FFmpeg demux bytes, complete decoded pictures, and all explicit PES frame timing boundaries; FFmpeg independently splits two field packets per PES with1800tick delta. No stereo output, arbitrary view selection, progressive browser decoding, native Wasm integration or performance claim.
